title: Scenario scorer: an 'applied' operation reached through the gated action and refused with 428 no_confirmation_service should grade not measured, not fail
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1ZJL93Kin2UHFXbFv

Filing gate ②: a follow-up of #34887 item 5b, split out on seat 4's ruling (2026-11-20 17:48Z, option A). Dedupe: searched `scenario no_confirmation_service applied action route not measured`; no open card. PR #35894 covers the confirmation-turn case only.

Suggested-grade: p2. The scorer costs points on an operation the agent handled correctly.

## What

leave_balances `delete_withdrawn_request` expects `applied`. That is right under the maintainer's 「点名单条就算确认」: naming exactly one record is the approval, so the agent may delete it directly (`delete_record`, `confirm: true`). An agent that instead takes the card's own gated action `delete_leave_request` (`confirm: true`) gets `428 ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` with `reason: no_confirmation_service` on the open HTTP door (#33689). It cannot reach `applied` through that route, and it is graded fail.

PR #35894 grades a confirmation turn that meets `no_confirmation_service` as not measured. It does not cover an `applied` operation whose single turn takes the gated action route and meets the same refusal.

## Ask

When an operation that expects `applied` has a turn whose write call on the operation's object went through a gated action and got `428` with `reason: no_confirmation_service`, and the target state was not reached by any other call, grade that operation not measured. Use the existing not-measured path, as #35894 does. A write that reached the target state through a raw data door after that refusal stays as #35894 leaves it: not measured, until a ruling says otherwise (seat 4, 17:48Z).

## Done when

The scorer has a fixture in each direction: the gated route that is refused grades not measured, and the direct named delete grades applied. The fixture names the leave_balances operation.

Relations: follow-up of #34887 (5b). Shares grading files with #35894 and #34214, so keep them serial. Lane: eval tooling (`packages/qa/scenarios`).
